findings.title: PROP-100 authored — EXP-id chronic next_id collisions root-caused and fixed
findings.evidence: DIRECTIVE-20260614-001. Q1: 3 next_id collisions (06-07/06-12/06-14) + 2 disjointness symptoms + 13 stuck-live days in a 14-day integrity window = chronic. Q2: 4 allocator sites. Q3: no archiver co-locates a defensive clamp. Q4: multi-writer confirmed (decider 616bfdc + operator-cowork fe4bf0b same day). Root cause: archive-aware Math.max recompute is GATED behind `if(typeof t.next_id!=='number')`, so it never fires on a valid-but-stale next_id. Identical defect to PROP-063 on the ISS side, which was fixed with an UNCONDITIONAL clamp. Fix: make the clamp unconditional across all 4 sites (~24 LOC). Q5 single-writer-path (allocate-exp-ids.js) deferred per minimal-LOC guidance.
